headline: Datamatics appoints new President & COO
hook: New COO to drive AI growth
summary: Datamatics Global Services Limited announced the appointment of Dr. Rajesh Gharpure as President and Chief Operating Officer. The move aims to accelerate the company’s AI‑led growth strategy. The leadership change could influence the firm’s performance and valuation. Investors in the listed company may see a shift in earnings outlook.
why_it_matters: Leadership change may boost AI initiatives
